tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Returns the weather forecast for a city for the next 7 days, with the high and low temperature in Celsius for each day. Use it when the user asks about upcoming weather; for the current conditions, use get_current_weather instead. Example: city "Tokyo", days 3.

city.description: The city's name, such as Tokyo.

days.description: How many days to return, 1 to 7.
